tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun ri khrod ma'i cho ga cha lag dang bcas pa sdig sgrib nad gdon zhi ba'i byin rlabs chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru sarba buddha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ ri khrod gnas su ri khrod ma'i/ /rnam par 'phrul pa'i skur sprul nas/ /'gro ba'i rims sogs sel mdzad ma/ /ri khrod lo ma can la 'dud/ /ri khrod dpal mo mnyes byas pas/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /dngos grub ma lus thob bya'i phyir/ /de'i man ngag rim pa bshad/ /de la 'di'am gzhan gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'am/ yang na smon 'jug gi sems bskyed thob pa zhig gis 'di'i rjes gnang dang lung sogs bzhugs pa'i bla ma dam pa las rjes gnang zhu tshul ni/ dben pa'i gnas su gzhi bzang po'i khar mañdzi'i steng du maṇḍal dri thig tshom bu gcig phyogs mtshams su chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod dang mdun du gtor ma/ slob dpon la ting shag me tog slob ma la maṇḍal nas bcas bshams nas mchod pa byin rlabs dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa sogs gzhan nas byung ba bzhin/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i bdag bskyed bsgom bzlas byas la maṇḍal yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ mchod bstod gtor ma/ yang mchod bstod 'dod gsol/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa rnams byas nas/ slob ma la paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i mtshams sbyor sogs rgyas bsdus ci rigs sngon du 'gro bas/ dngos gzhi rjes su bzlas pa dam bca' ba byin gyis brlabs pa'i lugs rnams so// dngos gzhi lung gsum gyi chings sogs brgya rtsa bzhin la/ lha sngags bsgyur/ rjes dam tshig bsdus te khas blang ba/ gtso bo sogs/ maṇḍal/ yon 'bul deng nas sogs/ chos bsngo/ bsod nams 'di yi sogs/ mdun bskyed la mchod bstod/ bzod gsol yig brgya ma 'byor ba sogs/

dang gshegs bsdu oṃ khyed kyi sogs/ bsngo ba bkra shis rnams bya'o/ /de ltar thob pa'i gang zag gis dben pa'i gnas su gtsang sbra dang sder dkar la gnas pa'i stegs kyi khar mchod gtor bshams/ bya rgyud spyi bsnyen/ bya tshul gyi bsnyen thabs sogs las 'byung zhing bsnyen pa bya tshul ni mchod pa byin rlabs nas brtsam ste bdag bskyed sgom bzlas byas la tadya thā/ a mṛ ta sogs/ rtsa sngags 'bum phrag gcig snying po oṃ pi sha tsi sogs/ 'bum phrag nyi shu hri hā yod pa'i pi sha tsi/ yang snying 'bum phrag bco lnga bya rin thun mtshams rnams su mdun gyi nam mkhar ri khrod ma spyan drangs la/ snying po'i mthar a kā ro btags pas gtor ma phul mchod bstod sogs rjes gnang bzhin bya ba ni bsnyen pa dang / sbyin sreg ni zhi ba'i thab khung bcas la lha sngags bsgyur ba ma gtogs dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i mi 'khrugs pa'i sbyin sreg sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin dang sngags kyi kha skong ni snying po bsnyen pa'i bcu cha bzlas pas don 'grub bo/ /bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'i gang zag gis 'gro ba'i rims nad bcad pa'i tshul la sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po ni sa phyogs dben zhing nyams dga' bar ba ba chu lci ba 'o ma mar zho lnga/ byung dang dri bzang gis byugs pa'i maṇḍal la tshon dkar po'i padma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbus 'dab brgyad la me tog tshom bu yang na rdul tshon dkar pos tshom bu bkod/ bkod pa'i dbus su bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dar ram ras dkar po'i mgul chings prog lnga pa'am bdun dang ldan pa bcings/ 'bras bu kham star li sogs 'bras bu bzang po 'byung ba'i/ can gyi shing rtse mo ma nyams pas kha brgyan/ rin po che lnga gser g.yu byu ru mu tig mu men/ sman lnga sle tre kanḍa ka ri/ shu dag dkar po/

rgya mtsho'i lbu ba/ dbang lag tsandan dkar dmar gur gum/ ga pur/ dza ti/ dri lnga/ snying po lnga tshwa bu ram 'o ma mar sbrang / 'bru lnga/ nas/ gro/ sran ma/ 'bras/ til/ dang bcas pas bkang ba'i steng du rin po che'i 'bras bu sder ma gser dngul shel sogs 'bras bus gang ba'i nang du/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel dang / 'di nyid kyi 'byor na rin chen dang me tog gang rung gi phreng ba'am de min gos ras gang rung gi skud pa bsgrims nas srog chags bal tshon gyis mi rung gzungs bzhugs shing / rab gnas dang ldan pa'i rnam rgyal mchod rten bzhugs su gzhug de'i steng du gdugs dkar po phub/ phyogs bzhir/ me tog tsam pa ka sogs lag khru gang tsam/ dkar po'i phreng ba gdags/ dri'am tog la 'byor na rin chen dang me tog gang rung gi phreng ba'am/ de min gos ras gang rung gi skud pa lnga bsgril bas srog chags bal tshon gyis mi rung / gzungs thag kyang bcings/ shin shun la sogs pa rtsa sngags sam/ snying po'i mjug tu sarba dzwa la rakṣaḥrakṣaḥ zhes pa tshar lnga gi waṃ gis dbus nas sgril gos ser gyi thum bcas kha brgyan/ bris pa bum pa'i khar bzhag khor yug tu chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang / gzhan yang mchod rdzas rnams kyis bskor/ bum rdzas las bshad pa'i sman lnga sogs bzang gras las mi rung sman dang dkar gsum zho/ 'o ma/ mar/ bla re sbrang rtsi/ ka ra/ mngar gsum gyis brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang / dmar gtor dang / yang dkar gtor gsum dang dmar gtor dang / yang dkar gtor dmar gtor gnyis dang / gang 'os pa'i gtor ma gcig dang dmar gtor gyi rigs rnams sha khrag smug rtsi sogs kyis brgyan/ dgu bshams/ gzhan yang ras sam dar dkar po khru gang gru bzhi la/ ba byung lngas ras 'dul byas la/ ri mo mkhan gyis lha mo mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/

g.yas na zhags pa dang dgra satwa/ g.yon na rma bya'i mjug sgro 'phyar ba dang / khu tshur dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub sgreng ba/ shing lo gsar pa me tog dang 'bras bur bcas pa'i na bza' klubs shing / rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ padma dang zla ba'i gdan la zhabs g.yas pa'i rting pas 'og sgo bsten pa'i pus mo gdan la btsugs pa/ bzhengs stabs su mdzad pa bris la/ spyan don gsal sogs nas gsungs pa'i rab gnas spyi 'gre/ dbye la sogs pa rab gnas byas te nad thams cad zhi bar mdzad pa'i mnga' bdag tu bsam la/ mchod pa rgya chen pos mchod cing bstod nas/ de dag gi spyan sngar rang nyid grogs dang bcas pa khrus bya/ gos gtsang ma gyon te/ gso sbyong gi thog mar phyag 'tshal ba ni/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te/ /kun gyi byed po bla ma yin/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /gang gi bka' drin 'od kyis gsal byas bdag nyid kyi/ /de nyid rin chen 'od kyi tshogs kyis mun bcom ste/ /mig skyon med rnams rol par bcas te steng du ni/ /lta gyur bla ma nyi ma de la phyag 'di bgyid/ /chos kun ro gcig stong nyid snying rje'i don rtogs nas/ /thar pa'i mchog gcig mi gnas myang 'das sgrub pa'i phyir/ /rgyal ba'i yum gcig phyag rgya chen po'i don ston pa/ /'gro ba'i skyabs gcig bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshogs gnyis zung 'jug zab mo'i lam la rab brten nas/ /rim gnyis zung 'jug thabs dang shes rab mthar phyin pas/

/bden gnyis zung 'jug legs bshad 'od kyi snang ba can/ /don gnyis lhun grub bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku gsum bdag nyid rgyal ba kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /theg gsum zab yangs dam chos rin chen 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bslab gsum rnam dag 'dus pa'i tshogs kyi 'dren pa mchog /skyabs gsum ngo bo bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnas skabs rigs bzhi'i kun rtog dang ldan 'gro ba rnams/ /rnam dag dbang bzhi'i dga' bde'i dpal la legs sbyar nas/ /zag med sku bzhi'i go 'phang mchog la 'god mdzad pa/ /tshad med bzhi ldan bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phung po lnga yi rang bzhin rnam dag chos kyi dbyings/ /mngon du gyur pa rgyal ba sku lnga'i bdag nyid can/ /dug lnga rnam dag shes bya'i don kun gzigs pa po/ /ye shes lnga ldan bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa'i tshig gis bla ma la phyag bya zhing / de bzhin du/ gang zhig thog ma dbus mtha' med cing sangs rgyas nyid rang rnams sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas nas ni ma rtogs rtogs phyir 'jig med rtag pa'i lam ston pa/ /mkhyen brtse'i ral gri rdo rje mchog rnams sdug bsngal myu gu gcod mdzad cing / /sna tshogs lta thibs kyis bskor the tshom brtsig pa 'jig mdzad de la 'dud/ /gang zhig med min yod min yod med ma yin yod med las gzhan du'ang / /brtag par mi nus nges tshig dang bral so so rang gi rig zhi ba/ /dri med ye shes 'od zer snang ldan dmigs pa kun la chags pa dang / /sdang dang rab rib rnam par 'joms mdzad dam chos nyi ma de la 'dud/ /sems de'i rang bzhin 'od gsal bas na nyon mongs ngo bo med gzigs pas/ /gang dag 'gro kun bdag med mtha' bzhi yang dag rtogs nas thams cad la/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rjes zhugs gzigs pa sgrib pa med pa'i blo mnga' ba/ /sems can rnam dag mtha' yas yul can ye shes gzigs mnga' de la 'dud/

/mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa po/ /bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i gzhi/ /de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pa'i 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu/ /dge bas ngan song las sgrol zhing / /gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa/ /zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston/ /bslab pa dag la rab tu gus/ /zhing gi dam pa yon tan zhing / /dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che/ /skyob pa bla med dam chos rin po che/ /'dren pa bla med dge 'dun rin po che/ /bla med dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyob pa chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsum rnams la yang rtag phyag 'tshal/ /dmigs med chos skur phyag 'tshal lo/ /longs spyod rdzogs skur༞ /cir snang sprul skur༞ /rnam dag chos kyi dbyings sgrub pa'i/ /'phags lam brgyad la༞ /ston pa'i dam chos thams cad la/ /rtag tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' dgra bcom pa/ /rang rgyal rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa la sogs pas dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal byas la/ gzhan yang / gcig min du ma ma yin bdag dang gzhan la phan pa phun sum tshogs chen gzhir gyur pa/ /dngos min dngos po med pa ma yin mkha' ltar ro gcig rtogs par dka' ba'i rang bzhin can/ /gos pa med cing mi 'gyur gzhi la mi mnyam mnyam pa khyab pa can te spros med pa/ /so sor rang rig rgyal ba rnams kyi chos sku dpe med gang yin de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rang gi 'byor pa 'jig rten las 'das bsam gyis mi khyab legs mdzad rgyal ba'i 'bras bu ni/ /blo ldan rnams kyi dga' ba bskyed phyir 'khor gyi nang du sna tshogs rgyas pa ston mdzad cing / /rtag tu dam pa'i chos kyi sgra skad rgya chen 'jig rten kun tu 'phro bar mdzad pa po/ /sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs sku chos kyi rgyal srid gnas pa gang yin de la phyag 'tshal lo/

/sems can rnams ni smin par mdzad phyir la la dag tu me 'bar bzhin du gang snang zhing / /la lar yang ni rdzogs pa'i byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu zhi bar gang snang la/ /sna tshogs thabs tshul rnams kyi rnam pa du ma 'jug cing srid pa gsum gyi 'jigs sel ba/ /phyogs bcur thub mdzad thub pa rnams kyi sprul sku don chen gang yin de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyan thos zhi ba tshol rnams kun shes nyid kyi nyer zhi khrid mdzad gang yin dang / /'gro la phan pa byed rnams lam shes nyid kyi 'jig rten don grub mdzad pa gang / /gang dang yang dag ldan pa'i thub rnams rnam pa kun ldan sna tshogs 'di gsung ba/ /nyan thos byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bcas sangs rgyas kyi ni yum de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin/ /ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid/ /so sor rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phra rab rdul gyi chos nyid 'das/ /pra phab pa yi rang bzhin can/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan ma/ /phyag rgya chen mo de la 'dud/ /stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /srid gsum skye 'jig med pa'i dngos/ /shes dang shes bya gcig pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan dus 'khor la phyag 'tshal/ /thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad bdag nyid gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /kyai rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /thabs kyis khro bo'i skur ston gdug pa 'dul/ /che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa/ /kun bzang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang / /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba rgyud lnga 'khor ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor gyis gzir 'gro gzigs nas/

/thugs rjes sdug bsnga'akhrul 'khor 'joms mdzad pa/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can smin cing grol bar mdzad pa'i phyir/ /sems can khams na bzhugs shing spyod gyur kyang / /chags pas ma gos padma ltar dag pa/ /'dod chags dag pas bdag nyid khyed la 'dud/ /sems can bkren pa chos kyis phongs gyur pa/ /ma rig 'thibs po'i nang du song ba rnams/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun dag gis tshim mdzad pa/ /ye shes sgron me khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor nub pa la/ /thugs rjes thabs dang shes rab grur zhugs te/ /zhi ba rin chen gling mchog skyel mdzad pa/ /kun gyi ded dpon khyed la kun nas 'dud/ /sems can las kyi chu bor grur nub rnams/ /dam chos bdud rtsis zab pas sgrol mdzad cing / /'phags lam yi ge brgyad la sbyor mdzad pa/ /gsung gi mnga' bdag khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi rten cing 'brel par 'byung / /'gag pa med pa skye med pa/ /rtag pa med pa chad med pa/ /'ong ba med pa 'gro med pa/ /tha dad don min don gcig min/ /spros pa nyer zhi zhi ston pa/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas smra rnams kyi/ /dam pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtog pa'i drwa ba rnam bsal cing / /zab cing rgya che'i sku mnga' ba/ /kun tu bzang po'i 'od zer dag /kun nas 'phro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshad med rnam thar zil gnon mdzad par nyon mongs nad dang bsam nas shes/ /rig dang mngon shes mtshan dpe yongs dag stobs dang mi 'jigs pa rnams dang / /bsrung med snyel med bag chags bcom dang snyel ba mi mnga' thugs rje che/ /ma 'dres bco brgyad rnam mkhyen dang ldan pha rol phyin rdzogs rnam la 'dud/ /sems can rnams la brtse ba can/ /phrad dang bral ba'i dgongs pa can/ /mi 'bral ba yi dgongs pa can/ /phan bde dgongs khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /thub pa'i sgrib kun nges par grol/ /'jig rten thams cad zil gyis gnon/

/khyod kyi mkhyen pa'i shes bya khyab/ /thugs grol khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can rnams ni thams cad kyis/ /nyon mongs ma lus thams cad 'dul/ /nyon mongs 'joms mdzad nyon mongs la/ /brtse bcas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhun gyis grub cing chags mi mnga'/ /thogs pa mi mnga' rtag pa yang / /mnyam par gzhag cing 'dri kun gyi/ /lan 'don khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bstan dang bstan pa bshad bya dang / /gsung dang mkhyen pa 'chad byed la/ /blo gros rtag thogs mi mnga' ba/ /legs ston khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gshegs nas spyod pa mkhyen mdzad de/ /de dag skad kyi sems can gyi/ /'ong dang 'gro dang nges 'byung la/ /legs 'doms khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lus can kun gyis khyod mthong na/ /skyes bu dam pa legs par 'tshal/ /mthong ba tsam gyis rab dwangs ba/ /mdzad pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /len dang gnas dang gtong ba dang / /sprul dang yongs su bsgyur ba dang / /ting nge 'dzin dang ye shes la/ /mnga' brnyes khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thabs dang skyabs dang dag pa dang / /theg chen nges par 'byung ba la/ /sems can rnams ni rab bslu ba'i/ /bdud 'joms khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang gzhan don du ye shes dang / /spangs dang nges 'byung gegs byed rnams/ /ston mdzad mu stegs gzhan dag gis/ /mi brdzi khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsrung med snyel ba mi mnga' ba'i/ /'khor gyi nang du bag rkyang gsungs/ /kun nas nyon mongs gnyis spangs pa/ /tshogs sdud khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun mkhyen khyod la rgyu ba dang / /gnas pa kun la rtag pa ni/ /kun mkhyen min spyod mi mnga' ba/ /yang dag don ldan khyod phyag 'tshal/ /lus can kun gyi bya ba la/ /khyod ni dus las mi mnga' zhing / /mdzad pa rtag tu don mnga' ba/ /mi snyel khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten kun la nyin mtshan du/ /lan drug tu ni so sor gzigs/ /thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa'i/ /phan dgongs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/

/spyod pa dang ni rtogs pa dang / /ye shes dang ni phrin las kyi/ /nyan thos rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi/ /bla ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku gsung dag gi byang chub che/ /rnam pa kun brnyes thams cad du/ /sems can rnams kyi the tshom dag /spyod pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dzin pa mi mnga' nyes mi mnga'/ /rnyog pa mi mnga' mi gnas pa/ /mi g.yo chos rnams thams cad la/ /spros med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grags chen shes rab chen po pa/ /thub chen dpa' bo chen po pa/ /srid pa'i mya ngan brgal ba po/ /nyon mongs brgal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khams gsum pa yi 'gro kun gyi/ /ngan song thams cad sbyong mdzad cing / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor mdzad pa/ /shākya seng ge de la 'dud/ /thabs mkhas thugs rje shākya'i rigs 'khrungs shing / /gzhan gyis mi thub bdud kyi dpung 'joms pa/ /gser gyi lhun po lta bur brjid pa'i sku/ /shākya'i rgyal po khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshan gyi me tog rgyas shing dag pa la/ /dpe byad bzang po'i 'bru chags mdzes pa'i sku/ /gang gis mthong thos dran pa'i dpal gyur pa/ /mtshan gyi rgyal po de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen zla dang padmas rab rgyas shing / /shes bya kun la mkhas shing mkhyen pa rgyas/ /rgya mtsho ltar bu zab pa'i sku mnga' ba/ /sgra dbyangs rgyal po de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dzam bu chu bo'i gser ltar lhang nge ba/ /nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i gzi brjid 'bar/ /dri med gser gyi mchod sdong lta bu'i sku/ /gser bzang dri med snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mya ngan 'das shing bde ba'i mchog brnyes nas/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal gdung ba sel mdzad pa/ /'gro drug mgon dang dpal du gyur pa yis/ /mya ngan med mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos sgra chen pos pha rol rgol ba 'joms/ /rgya mtsho lta bur zab pa'i gsung mnga' zhing / /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/

/chos kyi blo gros gting dpag dka' ba'i tshul/ /rnam dag chos kyi dbyings la rol mdzad cing / /shes bya ma lus mngon sum gzigs pa po/ /mngon mkhyen rgyal po de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyi ma lta bur ma rig mun pa sel/ /zla ba lta bur nyon mongs gdung ba sel/ /dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyas sman gyi bla/ /baiḍūrya yi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med/ /dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'joms pa'i dpal/ /mgon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams kyi skyabs/ /sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhyen rab dag pas shes bya kun gzigs nas/ /thugs rje ma lus 'gro la phan dgongs pa/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab mchog /byams mgon rgyal ba'i sras la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po/ /ye shes sgron mes rab brgyan cing / /'jig rten gsum gyi mun sel ba/ /'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni rgan yang gzhon nu mtha' dag rgyal ba'i sras po yin yang thog ma dang po'i sangs rgyas khyod/ /bud med sbyor zhing tshangs par spyod ldan mchog gi thugs rje dag gis 'jig rten gnyen te gshin rje'i dgra/ /khyod ni zhi yang rdo rje bzang po 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa 'phrog pa khyod ni rtag tu bdud kyi bdud/ /khyod ni grol yang srid pa 'dir ni 'gro ba smin pa'i don du 'jug mdzad 'jam dpal dbyangs la 'dud/ /ri bong 'dzin pa ltar dkar glegs bam ral gris phyag mtshan zhing / /rab mdzes shin tu zhi ba'i gzhon nu zur phud lnga dang ldan/ /dga' ba rgya chen thar mchog spyan ni padma'i 'dab ltar yangs/ /blo gros ngan pa bsreg mkhas 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi dbu brgyan can/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs/ /spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig srid pa'i 'ching ba rnams las grol yang sems can don du srid pa 'dzin/

/de ni stong pa'i don dag ston mdzad dus las las kyi 'bras bu stong ma lags/ /sems kyi dri ma yang dag ye shes mes bsreg rtag tu yang dag brtse bas brlan/ /mdzad spyod rtag min sems can don la dges pa'i sangs rgyas de la bdag cag 'dud/ /stobs po che la drag shul che/ /rigs lnga rgyal po dge ba po/ /gdul dka' mtha' dag 'dul mdzad pa/ /rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos dbyings rang bzhin ind+ra ni la'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs zung brjid pa'i sku/ /ye shes ral gri rdo rje zhags pa bsnams/ /khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha dang lha min cod pan gyis/ /zhabs kyi padmo la btud de/ /phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma/ /sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog /zhal gsum phyag brgyad rab mdzes zhi ba'i sku/ /ye shes dpag yas tshe yi mchog stsol ma/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes bla ma 'od kyi tog /de ni smon lam blo gros dang / /dbang po zhi dang 'jam dbyangs la/ /bdag ni gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal te/ slar yang / dus gsum gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas kun/ /chos dang tshogs kyi mchog bcas la/ /zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi/ /lus btud pa yis bdag phyag 'tshal/ /byang chub sems kyi gzhi rnams dang / /mchod rten kun la'ang phyag 'tshal zhing / /mkhan po de bzhin slob dpon dang / /brtul zhugs mchog la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' ltar khyab pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas la/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /lus 'di zhing rdul mnyam par rab sprul nas/ /rtag tu gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa la sogs pas kyang phyag 'tshal rgyas bsdus ji ltar 'os pa dang / ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ na bza' dam pa nas phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi'i bar rol mo 'bud dkrol/

tsog pur 'dug nas 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs 'phros rnams bya'o/ /zhes pa nas/ thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir bsngo zhes sogs kyis yan lag bdun pa phul/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa ste phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas tshe thog ma med pa nas tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug gi dbang gis lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sgo nas sdig pa mi dge ba bcu bgyis pa dang / mtshams med pa lnga bgyis pa dang / de dang nye ba lnga bgyis pa dang / so sor thar pa'i sdom pa la 'gal ba bgyis pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya dang 'gal ba bgyis pa dang / gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dang 'gal ba bgyis pa dang / dkon mchog gsum la ma gus pa bgyis pa dang / pha dang ma la ma gus pa bgyis pa dang / mkhan po dang slob dpon la ma gus pa༞ grogs tshangs par mtshungs pa rnams la༞ dam pa'i chos spangs pa dang / gsung rab kyi glud zos pa dang / 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la bskur ba btab pa la sogs pa mdor na mtho ris dang thar pa'i gegs su gyur cing 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyur gyur pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes pa dang ltung ba'i tshogs ci bgyis pa dang / bgyid du stsal ba dang / gzhan bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba bgyis pa de dag thams cad bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so/ /mi 'chab bo/ /mi sbed do/ /slan chad kyang sdom par bgyid lags so/ /lan gsum gyis sdig pa bshags/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rta cang shes lta bu/

glang po chen po/ bya ba byas shing byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ rang gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid pa kun tu sbyor ba/ yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i bka'/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i thugs/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i shes rab can de dag gis sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir dang / phan par bya ba'i phyir dang / grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang / nad med par bya ba'i phyir dang / mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang / byang chub kyi mchog gi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir du gso sbyong nges par blangs pa de bzhin du/ bdag gis kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du/ gso sbyong nges par yang dag par blang bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum bya'o/ /deng nas srog gcod mi bya zhing / /gzhan gyi nor yang blang mi bya/ /'khrig pa'i chos kyang mi spyad cing / /rdzun gyi tshig kyang mi smra'o/ /skyon ni mang po nyer bstan pa'i/ /chang ni yongs su spang bar bya/ /khri stan che mtho mi bya zhing / /de bzhin dus ma yin pa'i zas/ /dri dang phreng ba dang ni rgyan/ /gar dang glu sogs spang bar bya/ /ji ltar dgra bcom rtag tu ni/ /srog gcod la sogs mi byed ltar/ /de bzhin du ni bdag gis kyang / /deng nas srog gcod la sogs spang / /sdug bsngal mang 'khrugs sems can rnams/ /srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /lan gsum bya'o/ /oṃ a mo gha shī la sambha ra sambha ra/ bha ra bha ra/ mahā shuddha sarba padma bhi bhu ṣi ta bhū dza dha ra dha ra/ sa mantā a wa lo ki te hūm̐ phaṭa/ nyi shu rtsa gcig bzla/ khrims kyi tshul khrims skyon med cing / /tshul khrims rnam par dag dang ldan/ /rlom sems med pa'i tshul khrims kyis/ /tshul khrims pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /de dag ni sbyor ba'i cho ga'o/ /gzhi la gzungs kyi sgrub pa dang /

zhar las byung ba khrus kyi cho ga'o/ /dang po la bdag bskyed bsgoms bzlas dang / bum pa'i cho ga dang sbyin sreg dang / gtor ma btang ba'o/ /dang po ni sngon 'gro gtor ma rdo rje 'thor g.yab dang bcas dri bzang gi chu 'thor a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ rdo rje bsdams pa 'debs pa'i tshul byas la/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇaṃ adya nutpanna twata oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum brjod pas ci 'dod pa'i yo byad thams cad thogs pa med par bsam zhing / rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas lha klu gnod sbyin 'byung po'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas spyan drangs par bsam zhing / tshig de dag re re'i mjug tu lag pa g.yas pas rdo rje g.yab cing / g.yon dril bu gsil zhing / lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul/ /nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzang lus srul po/ /dri za srin po gdon gyi tshogs rnams dang / /gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /bud med bcas shing g.yog 'khor bcas pa la/ /bdag gi pus mo sa la btsugs nas ni/ /thal mo sbyar nas khyed la gsol 'debs kyi/ /gsan nas phan gdags slad du 'dir gshegs shig /oṃ sarba lo ka kā ra e hye his spyan drangs/ padma'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ padma ka ma la ya satwaṃ gyis gdan phul/ mchod pa so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing / nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ de wa/ nā ga yakṣa/ rakṣa sa/ gandharba/ a su ra/ ga ru ḍa/ kiṃ na ra/ ma ho ra ga ma nu ṣya/ a ma nu ṣya/ sa pa ri wā ra/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyoḥbi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba thā khaṃ/ udga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ ghṛhṇa daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul la/ g.yas rdo rje thugs ka dang / g.yon dril bu chig brdung bya zhing / 'byung po gang dag nas/

'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye zhes pa'i bar/ 'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang / /dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yi gnas rnams dang / /shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyim rnams dang / /ri bo kun la gang dag gnas pa dang / /rin chen gling na lhag par gang gnas dang / /chu bo kun dang chu bo'i mdo rnams dang / /mtsho dang rdzing bu ltengs ka chu ngogs dang / /g.ya' chu sil ma can na gang gnas dang / /grong dang phyugs lhas grong khyer stong pa dang / /khang stong dag dang lha yi gnas rnams dang / /gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten gnas rnams dang / /bka' thub gnas dang glang chen bres rnams dang / /rgyal po'i dkor khang dag na gang gnas dang / /lam srang gsum mdo dang ni bzhi mdo dang / /gang dag lam po che dang shing gcig drung / /dur khrod chen po nags tshal chen po dang / /seng ge dred dang gcan gzan gnas rnams dang / /'brog chen 'jigs su rung bar gang gnas dang / /gang dag gling mchog dag na gnas pa dang / /lhun grub dur khrod dag na gnas pa rnams/ /rab tu dges shing mgu bar gyur nas su/ /phreng ba me tog dri dang bdug par bcas/ /bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na/ /'di dag gsol zhing legs par bzhes nas kyang / /bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /ces pas phrin las bcol zhing / chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung / /de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas bstan/ /rgyu la 'gog pa gang yin pa/ /dge sbyong chen pos 'di skad gsungs/ /sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /lus kyi sdom pa legs pa de/ /ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin/ /yid kyi sdom pa legs pa de/ /thams cad du ni sdom pa legs/ /thams cad bsrung ba'i dge slong dag /sdug bsngal kun las de grol lo/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/

/bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med par/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye/ /zhes pas chos kyi sbyin pa sbyin la/ rdo rje thugs ka dril bu rgyun dkrol bya zhing / de ltar lha klu gnod sbyin 'byung po'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang / bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi chos sgrub pa'i bar chad nye bar zhi ba dang / bsam pa'i don thams cad chos dang mthun pa yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba lo ka kā ra gṛhṇe daṃ arghaṃ swāhā/ zhes pa dang mtheb srin gyis se gol phyir gtog cing gatstsha zhes pas gshegs su gsol/ gtor ma gtsang sar dor zhing / rdo rje gsor dril bu drag tu dkrol zhing / gzhan yang rol mo'i sgra drag po dang bcas pas/ na maḥs manta kā ya wakka tsitta badzrā ṇāṃ/ na mo badzra kro dha ya ma hā daṃṣṭi ka ṭa bhai ra wa ya/ a si mu sa la pa ra shu ba hastā ya/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li kha kha khā hi khā hi/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha/ bandha bandha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ gardza gardza/ bi spho ṭa ya bi spho ṭa ya/ sarba bighnān bi na ya kā nān/ mahā ga na pa ti/ dzi wi ta/ an ta ka rā ya swāhā/ mtshams bcad pa ni/ thal mo sbyar la/ rgya gar skad du/ arya parṇaṇa/ sha wa ri nā ma dha ra ṇi/ bod skad du/ 'phags ma ri khrod ma lo ma gyon ma zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags ma ri khrod ma lo ma gyon ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/

/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mthu chen po thob pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das ma mi'u thung sha za mo ri khrod ma lo ma gyon ma dgra satwa dang zhags pa 'dzin ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs pa gang dag ci byung ba de dag thams cad yams kyi nad gang ci byung yang rung ba dang / 'chi byed gang dag ci yang rung ba dang / 'chi byed chen po gang dag ci yang rung ba dang / gnod pa gang dag ci yang rung ba dang / 'khrug pa gang dag ci yang rung ba dang / khong du gnod pa gang dag ci yang rung ba dang / gang dag ci byung ba de dag thams cad ni byis pa kho na la 'byung gi mkhas pa la ni ma yin no/ /bden pa bden pa'i ngag gis song zhig dengs shig mkhas pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag gis bdag dang sems can thams cad la srung bar mdzod cig yongs su skyabs par mdzod cig yongs su bzung bar mdzod cig yongs su bskyang bar mdzod cig zhi ba dang bde legs su mdzod cig chad pa spang bar mdzod cig mtshon cha spang bar mdzod cig ji srid du gzhom pa'i bar du mdzod cig me'i gnod pa spang bar mdzod cig chu'i gnod pa spang bar mdzod cig byad stems bcad par mdzod cig mtshams bcing bar mdzod cig sa gzhi bcing bar mdzod cig tadya thā/ a mṛ te a mṛ ta ud bha be/ a mṛ ta saṃ bha be/ ā shwa te/ ā shwa satwaṃ ge mā ma ra/ mā ma ra/ mā sa ra mā sa rā/ zhi bar mdzod/ nad thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzod/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzod/ gza' dang rgyu skar gyi nyes pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzod cig mche ba'i dug thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzod/ bcom ldan 'das ma ri khrod ma lo ma can tunna tunna/ bi tunna bi tunna/ rū ṇa rū ṇa/ rū mu le swāhā/ oṃ gau rī/ gandhā ri/

tsanḍā lī/ mā taṃ gi pukka sī swāhā/ oṃ aṃ ku re/ maṃ ku re/ ku ra re parṇa sha ba rī swāhā/ na maḥsarba sha ba rī ṇāṃ/ mahā sha ba rī ṇāṃ/ bha ga wa ti pi sha tsī/ parṇa sha ba ri pi shā tsi swāhā/ pi shā tsi parṇa sha ba ri hrīḥdzaḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ pi shā tsi swāhā/ 'phags ma ri khrod ma lo ma gyon ma'i gzungs rdzogs so/ /de nas gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad la dri bzang gi chu dang / a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bhrūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhis mdzes shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du mchod rdzas rnams oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ gzhan yang rol mo dang 'phan gdugs la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur par bsam la/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ shāpta aḥhūm̐/ sogs so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ rol mo ji snyed yod pa'i sgra bya zhing / dharma ra ṇi tshar gsum brjod do/ / gsum brjod pa'i dang po rang gis byin gyis brlabs pa las kyang gzi brjid phun sum tshogs par byin gyis brlabs par mos/ gnyis las phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab par byon par mos/ gsum pa'i tshe 'di dag gi byin gyis brlab par mos/ de nas bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/

/rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /de nas thal mo sbyar zhing / bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes lan gcig sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'phags ma ri khrod ma lo ma gyon ma'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ rang skad cig gis 'phags ma ri khrod mar gsal ba'i snying kha'i steng du padma dang zla ba'i snyeng du paṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo ri khrod lo ma can gyi dbu rgyan du bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam par bzhugs pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ na maḥparṇaṇa sha ba ri bhyaḥ oṃ parṇaṇa sha ba ri sa pa ri wās arghaṃ sogs nas/ shapta pra tītstsha āḥhūm̐/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i sogs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs dang / stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i ljon shing sna tshogs pa'i nags tshal dang / me tog sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i steng du paṃ las padma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ rang gi shes pa paṃ yig gser gyi mdog can de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ khyad par du nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad bsal/ slar 'dus nas paṃ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ri khrod lo ma can sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/

zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa ba'i zhal ser zhing 'dzum khro'i tshul can/ g.yas zhal dkar po zhi ba'i nyams can/ g.yon zhal dmar po chags pa'i nyams can/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos thugs kar rdo rje gnyis pas dgra satwa 'degs pa'i tshul/ gsum pas mda' gsor zhing 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi dang pos sdigs mdzub la rdo rje zhags pa dkris pa/ gnyis pas 'bras bu dang me tog gis spungs pa'i shing lo gsar pa'i sbrang g.yab/ gsum pas gzhu 'dzin pa/ rin po che dang me tog sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis spras shing / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dmar po'i stod g.yogs dang / me tog dang 'bras bu du mas spras pa'i shing lo gsar pa gshibs pas smad g.yogs can/ sbrul dkar pos se ral kha byas pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs gyen du bcings shing / lang tsho dar la babs pa/ sku shin tu mdzes shing grim pa/ cung zad khro ba/ zhabs g.yas pa'i rting pas 'og gi phyogs bsten zhing / pus mo gdan la btsugs pa/ g.yon pas bzhengs stabs su mdzad pa/ rnam par 'gyings pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ yang phyag gnyis ma dmar mo'i sbyin sreg gi dus yin na/ phyag bzhi ma sngon mo drag po'i dus yin zhing / 'dir ni ser mo gtso che'o/ /ser mo ma gtogs rang rang gi sku mdog phyag mtshan ni/ 'phags pa rin po che'i cho gar gsal lo/ /de ltar bsgom pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ snying kha'i nang du nyi ma la gnas pa'i paṃ ser po bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas paṃ las sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun ri khrod lo ma gyon ma la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs pa la/ sngar bzhin mchod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas rang dang gnyis su med par bstim mo/ /yang paṃ gyi yi ge de nyid las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra sngon du 'gro bas/

pa spyan drangs la snga ma ltar mchod nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas de rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/ lus kyi dri ma thams cad dag gsang sngags dang phrin las thams cad dbang bar byas/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsam mo/ /de nas lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu la rang gi sems gtad la mnyam par gzhag go /gang gi tshe sngags bzla bar 'dod na/ de'i tshe snying ga'i nang gi paṃ yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba'i 'od kyis/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi rgyud bskul bas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs shing bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang / nad thams cad bsal bar bsam la/ oṃ pi shā tsi parṇaṇa sha ba ri sarba dzwa ra pra sha ma ṇa ya zhes pa ni snying po'o/ /oṃ pi shā tsi parṇaṇa sha ba ri hrī hā hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes bya ba ni nye ba'i snying po'o/ /'di'i rtsa ba'i sngags bzla bar 'dod na gzungs nyid las 'byung ba bzhin bzla bar bya'o/ /bsnyen pa'i grangs ni rtsa ba'i sngags 'bum phrag gcig snying po 'bum phrag nyi shu/ yang snying 'bum phrag bco lnga las thams cad ji skad bshad pa bzhin 'grub par gyur ro/ /rtsa sngags ni tadya thā/ a mṛ te/ a mṛ te/ a mṛ ta ud bha be/ a mṛ ta saṃ bha we/ ā shwa te/ ā shwa taṃ ge mā ma ra/ mā ma ra/ mā sa ra/ mā sa ra/ tunna tunna/ bi tunna bi tunna/ tū ṇa tū ṇa/ tū lu le swāhā/ oṃ gau rī/ gandha rī/ tsaṇḍa lī/ mā taṃ gi pukka sī swāhā/

oṃ aṃ ku re/ māṃ ku re/ ku ra re/ parṇaṇa shā ba ri swāhā/ na maḥsarba shā wa rī nāṃ mahā shā wa rī ṇāṃ bha ga wa ti pi shā tsi parṇaṇa sha wa rī pi sha tsi swāhā/ oṃ pi sha tsi parṇaṇa sha wa ri hri dzaḥhūm̐ phaṭa pi sha tsi swāhā/ de ltar bzlas pa'i rjes su bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim/ zhes brjod/ bdag bskyed do/ /bum pa'i cho ga ni/ ku shas dri bzang gi chu bum pa dang mchod rdzas rnams la gtor zhing / oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas ma dag pa bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas thams cad stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung pa'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du mchod rdzas rnams oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon zhes pa nas/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes pa'i bar gnas yo byin rlabs kyi skabs bzhin la/ ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ so so'i sngags phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ dri chu dang a mṛ tas bum pa bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i bum pa'i steng du paṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrūṃ yig dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rin po che'i mchod rten/

rin po che'i khri'i steng du padma/ de'i steng du khri zlum po bang rim gsum pa/ de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du bum pa zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba sgo dang bcas pa/ de'i steng du bre/ de'i steng du gdugs rim pa bcu gsum/ char kheb tog dang bcas pa/ me tog gi phreng ba dang / dar gyi lda ldes mdzes par byas pa'i mchod yon gyi bum pa'i nang du paṃ las padma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du paṃ yig gser gyi mdog can las 'od zer 'phros pas zhes sogs lha mo bdag bskyed bzhin bsgoms gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas ri khrod lo ma can la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba spyan drangs te/ spos dang bcas shing rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru/ /'gro la brtse phyir thugs rje rnam sbyangs shing / /smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na/ /de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ /rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing / /mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral bya'i phyir/ /yongs dag 'khor dang bcas rnams gshegs su gsol/ /chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing / /nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che/ /dad pas spyan ni drang bar bgyi/ /zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pa/ /dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs/ /chos dang ye shes chags bral ba/ /kun tu mi zad nus par ldan/ /tshur spyon tshur spyon zhi bdag lha/ /thub pa skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen/ /shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni/

/mchod pas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ /'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang / /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ /oṃ e hye hi bha ga wan mahā kā rū ṇi ka ārya pi sha tsi parṇa sha wā ri sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badzra sa māḥdzaḥ zhes pas sbyangs/ ye shes sems dpa'i phyi bzhin nang 'brang nas bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs log 'dren thams cad 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig zhes dang rdor dril gsor dkrol/ na mo badzra kro dha sogs sngon 'gro gtor ma bzhin gyis phyir 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan/ /bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod/ /bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /pad kor sngon 'gro'i mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga to ga ga na sa ma ya hūm̐ swāhā/ mchod yon dbul/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ lha yi chu ni dag pa yi/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /g.yas pas khrus gsol ba'i stangs ka byed cing / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes pas khrus gsol/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /padma'i phyag rgya dang bcas la/ oṃ padma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ zhes pas gdan phul la/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gros mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ dbu rgyan gyi bar bdag bskyed bzhin/ de'i phyi rol gyi steng gi nam mkha' la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa dang /

khor yug tu chos skyong srung ma dang / 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyis bskor bar gyur/ de dag la gong du bstan pa'i mchod pa rnams kyis rim pa bzhin du mchod par bsam zhing / so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang / /bdag gis gus pas bshams pa 'di/ /ri khrod lo ma gyon ma dang / /rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis/ /nad gdon bgegs rnams zhi ba dang / /dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta parṇa sha wa ri sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes mchod yon dbul/ de bzhin du mchod yon gyi gnas su zhabs bsil dang / arghaṃ gyi gnas su pādyaṃ la zhabs bsil me tog dang puṣpe/ bdug spos dang dhū pe/ mar me dang dī paṃ/ dri mchog dang gandhe/ zhal zas dang nai wi te/ sil snyan dang shapta zhes pa rnams kyis mchod nas rol mo dbul/ rgyal srid sna bdun 'dod yon lnga kun rig bzhin/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yi/ /cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa las byung ba'i/ /lha mo gang zhig bsgrub pa'i nad gdon bgegs/ /kun tu zhi mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhing dang yul rnams kun rig rnams 'phrul zhing / /khyad par ri khrod gnas su rnam rol nas/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub kun stsol ba'i/ /ri khrod dbang phyug ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sna tshogs zhal dang phyag zhabs sna tshogs dang / /sna tshogs mdog dang cha lugs sna tshogs dang / /sna tshogs rgyan dang phyag mtshan sna tshogs kyis/ /rnam par sgeg ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod kyi gang gis 'dul ba'i thabs mkhyen nas/ /me tog 'bras bu du mas rnam spud cing / /shing lo gsar pa'i na bza' rab klubs pa'i/ /lo ma gyon ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsung gi rigs lnga zhi ba'i nga ro yis/

/'gro ba'i rims nad sdug bsngal zhi mdzad cing / /drag po'i gsang sngags 'brug ltar cher bsgrags pas/ /gdug pa 'joms mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyid thugs zhi bas 'gro ba zhi mdzad cing / /brtse bas rjes chags dges pa chen po yis/ /tshe dang dpal 'byor rnam par rgyas mdzad ma/ /rnam par yangs pa'i thugs mnga' khyod la 'dud/ /sgrub dang bzlas brjod brtson pas nyid kyi thugs/ /bskul bas bdag la brtse bas nyer dgongs te/ /nad dang bgegs kyi tshogs rnams zhi ba dang / /tshe dang dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /skye ba kun tu bdag gi mgon mdzad de/ /nyam nga 'jigs pa kun las skyabs pa dang / /srid zhi'i bde dga' rgya mtshor rab 'byor zhing / /rdzogs sangs yon tan rgya mtshor 'gyur bar shog /ces pas bstod cing gsol ba gdab bo/ /gzhan yang 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab bo/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod sogs/ /de nas sgrub pa'i grogs dang bcas pas gzungs thag gzung la/ rang gi snying kha nas sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros nas/ gzungs thag la brten nas song bas/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i rgyud bskul nas sku'i cha las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa babs pas bum pa'i nang gang ba dang / 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros pas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rims nad dang / bgegs dang 'byung po thams cad kyi gnod pa zhi bar bsam zhing / 'di'i snying po'i snying po stong / nye snying lnga brgya shub bu/ rtsa sngags 'phreng skor 'ur 'don bcom ldan 'das mas sogs 'dod gsol bdag bskyed bzhin/ sngags gtso bor bzla'o/ /rtsa sngags dang nye ba'i snying po ci rigs bzlas so/ /thun gyi mthar gong bzhin mchod pa kha gso byin gyis brlabs nas/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho mdzad srol/ bstod pa gong bzhin 'dod gsol bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod sogs mchod cing bstod la nad zhi bar gsol ba gdab bo/

/bum pa'i cho ga'o/ /sbyin sreg ni sa stegs sam/ zhal ba'am snod khru sgor ma sogs ji ltar rigs par zhi ba'i thab khung zlum po kha khyer mu ran zlum po stegs bu gru bzhi cho ga bcas pa'i mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng ba stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i gra bzhir zla phyed rdo rje/ thab nang padma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su tshom bu dmar po'am nas 'bras gang rung gis bkod/ de'i drung du chu gnyis nyer mchod sbreng tshar du bshams/ snod ji ltar rigs pas mi skra mi rus shing nim pa'i lo ma rtsa dur wa mar rnams lhan cig tu bzhag thab khung dri chu dang / a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i nang du paṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du paṃ yig dmar po/ de las 'od 'phros pas sems can gyi don byas khyad par du nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad bsal/ slar 'dus nas paṃ la thim zhing de yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das ma ri khrod lo ma can du gyur pa ni sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas pa rdo rje dang bcas pa'i khu tshur gyis bgegs kyi tshogs la bsnun par mdzad cing / g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pas gnod par byed pa thams cad kun gzir bar dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing / khro gnyer bsdus pa/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs shing lto ba 'phyang ba sku thung zhing brjid la sbom pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar ba rus pa dang rin po che dang sbrul gdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ gnas gsum byin gyis rlabs nas sa mā dzaḥ'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin dang / ma lus nas rigs bdag rgyas 'debs kyi bar bum chog bzhin la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan zhes brjod/

spyan 'dren gyi tshe mdun bskyed kyi bum pa'i drung du me tog snod spos rengs dang bcas pa bzhag la las kyi rdo rjes phyag gsum phul nas kha ras lag lcib dang bcas pas blang la spyan 'dren dang bstun slob dpon la phul/ slob dpon gyis spos kyi rtse cung zad btogs/ 'bru phran bu dang bcas pa thab nang du gtor/ byings nye 'khor gyi stegs khar bzhag mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs nas/ bstod pa rdzogs pa'i mtshan sngags sogs sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod shlau ka gcig bar gong bzhin bya/ de nas mi skra sogs gong gi rdzas rnams brgya rtsa brgyad snying po'i dbul ba'i mthar bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas thog drangs sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib des bskyed pa'i/ bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad dang khyad par du yang / dus min gyi rims nad gdon bgegs ma rungs pa'i gdug rtsub cho 'phrul thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes brjod yang mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i mchod pa bstod pa gong bzhin/ 'dod gsol kyang spel tshig bzhin cho 'phrul ngan pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes sbyar/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang shlau ka gcig oṃ khyed kyi sems can gyi mthar badzra muḥ thab nang gi ye shes pa mchod rten gyi bum nang gi lha la thim par gyur/ zhes brjod la spos sbar las kyi rdo rjes slob dpon la phyag gsum phul nas spos snod bcas blangs la/ 'bru nas mchod rten dang bum pa la cung zad gtor/ byings sngar shul du bzhag sbyin sreg 'di ma byung yang chad pa'i skyon med/ gtor ma rnams a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i kha dog dang dri dang ro dang nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bskyed la/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes yang yang brjod la byin gyi brlabs so/ /gtor ma dgu yod pa'i dang po bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du bstab pas gsol bar bsam zhing / rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ pi shā tsi parṇa sha wa ri sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇa pa ya sarba dzwa la pra sha ma ṇa ye swāhā/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis phul la/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yi/ /shlau ka gcig gis bstod/ lo ma gyon ma 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /sogs kyis phrin las gzhol/ de bar rol mo 'bud dkrol bya'o/ /gnyis pa chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul ba ni 'bru gsum lan gsum/ gur zhal sogs la rang rang gi gtor chog bsdus pas phul chog pas/ gdan sa 'di nyid kyi phyag len ltar na bskyed chog nas 'phrin nang mchod mi dgos/ 'chol rdzogs pa'i bar gtor bsngo sbags sgrub bzhin la gur lcam dral zhal rnams kyi sngags thung gi mthar/ sangs rgyas bstan srung ma bsdus pa sbyar la bstan srung 'khor dang bcas la bstod kyi rjes su/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar/ gtor ma de nyid 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la rgyal chen bzhi la 'bul tshul tshe dpag med sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar ro// ༈ /rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor bsngo dang mjug chog lam rim man lam bcas dge rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal po chen po bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ e hye hi tsa turma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs pas dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhir bzhugs nas gtor mar gsol bar bsams/ oṃ dhi ta raṣṭa ya/ bi ru ḍhā kā ya/ bi ru pakṣa ya/ bai shra ma ṇa ya/ sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyeḥzhes sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgya lan gsum gyis phul/

tsa turma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ rgyal po chen po dpal ldan pa/ /margad mdog can pi waṃ 'dzin/ /dri za'i tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba/ /yul 'khor srung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo chen po stobs po che/ /kha dog sngon po ral gri 'dzin/ /grul bum tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba/ /'phags skyes po la༞ mnga' bdag chen po mthu bo che/ /kha dog dmar po sbrul zhags 'dzin/ /klu yi tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba/ /mig mi bzang la༞ /ded dpon chen po gser mdog can/ /be con dang ni ne'u le 'dzin/ /gnod sbyin tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba/ /rnam thos sras la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/ rgyal po chen po 'khor bcas rnams/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhes sogs kyis 'phrin las bcol/ bsdu na/ dad ldan rgyal ba'i bka' thos zhal mthong shing / /sgrub la brtson pas sangs rgyas thugs su chud/ /thabs dang snying rjes gzhan don rdzogs mdzad pa'i/ /bdag dang gzhan don 'byor pa khyed la 'dud/ /mjug chog skabs dgos pa ni/ 'di ltar sgrub pa'i dge ba 'di yi mthus/ /bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag gis/ /thogs med nas bsags tshe thung 'gyur ba yi/ /las sgrib ma lus byang zhing dag gyur cig /'gro kun dga' bde'i dpal la rtag 'god phyir/ /bsod nams 'di yis bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /nad dang gdon med dus 'dir tshe ring ba'i/ /mthar thug gyur nas bsam don kun 'grub shog /de ltar 'chi med dpal la longs spyod cing / /bdag cag rnams kyi spyod lam phra mo tshun/ /ma lus bstan dang 'gro ba'i don gyur nas/ /rgyal sras spyod pas don gnyis lhun grub shog /pha rol phyin dang bya spyod rnal 'byor gyi/ /rgyud sde'i don la sbyangs pa mthar phyin te/ /rtse gcig theg mchog rim gnyis rnal 'byor gyi/ /dpe yi ye shes tshe 'dir 'char bar shog /skyabs gnas bslu med rnams kyi thugs rje dang /

/bdag gi dad pa'i shugs dang chos kyi dbyings/ /bden pa'i stobs kyis bdag cag dpon slob kyi/ /'di phyi'i don kun yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig/ //dge'o// //gsum pa phyogs skyong dang bzhi pa 'byung po la cha gsum bzhin 'bul/ lnga pa 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ brta li brta li mahā brta li hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥswāhā/ oṃ klu rgyal mtha' yas nor rgyas bu/ /'jog po dang ni stobs kyi rgyu/ /padma padma chen po dang / /dung skyong dang ni rigs ldan dang / /lha mo lha mo chen mo dang / /zla ba'i spyi gtsug spyi gtsug che/ /dbyug 'dzin dbyug 'dzin chen po dang / /sog ma med dang hu lun ta/ /dga' bo dang ni nyer dga' bo/ /rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po dang / /tsha ba tsha ba chen po dang / /dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che/ /rin chen 'od dang gzugs mdzes dang / /gzugs mdzes chen po sbrul bzang dang / /lto 'phye chen po tshi li dang / /tshi li chen po rnams dang ni/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ā gatstsha ya ā gatstsha ya/ sarba bhur bhu ba phruṃ phruṃ swāhā/ padma ka ma la ya stāṃ/ nā ga sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs/ dril bu dkrol la/ gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ni/ sa 'og mun pa mtha' dag sel mdzad cing / /bstan la rab dga' sprul pa bsam mi khyab/ /klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ hi li hi li mahā hi li phruṃ phruṃ swāhā/ oṃ bhakṣa ya bhakṣa ya sa ma ya tiṣṭha dzuṃ phruṃ phu hūm̐ swāhā/ lan gsum/ dril bu rgyun chags su dkrol la de ltar na/ klu'i rgyal po brgyad kyis gtso byas pa'i klu gnyan sa bdag gi rigs thams cad dang / khyad par du yang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la gnod cing lan chags pa'i klu gnyan sa bdag gi rigs thams cad gtor ma 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rgya mtsho chen po 'dis tshim zhing mnyes nas gnod pa dang gdug pa'i bsam pa zhi nas phan pa dang zhi ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig

nā ga sa pa ri wā ra gatstsha ga ru ḍa bya khyung gi phyag rgya/ haṃ sa ne tsa le swāhā/ drug pa 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor spyi 'gre bzhin la/ shāpta aḥhūm̐ gi rjes su/ lha'i tshogs rnams nas/ kun 'grub shog gi bar/ 'di'i rjes su 'og gi gzhi bdag gtor ma yar 'then/ mtheb srin gyis se gol phyir gtog gtor ma bdun pa dang brgyad pa gnyis phyir gtor/ dmar gtor a mṛ ta sogs swa bhā wa༞ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las sogs nas 'bru gsum gyi bar gtso gtor bzhin no/ /bdun pa 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi khams kyi nad bdag gdug pa can sha khrag la dga' ba thams cad ā karṣa ya dzaḥ a ka ros bsngos pa'i mthar/ thal mo sbyar la de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ dril bu rgyun chags su dkrol la/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di ni nad bdag rims bdag yams kyi bdag mo la sogs pa gdug pa can gnod byed kyi tshogs ngos ma zin pa sa dang bar snang la gnas nas 'dod pa'i gegs phyed cing mi 'dod pa bskyed par byed pa sha khrag srog dbugs la longs spyod pa rnams la sbyin no/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas thog drangs sems can thams cad la rims nyin gcig pa dang / nyin gnyis pa dang / nyin gsum pa dang / nyin bzhi pa dang / nyin bdun pa dang / rtag pa'i rims rnams dang / rims mi zad pa rnams dang / rims ldang dub pa rnams dang / 'byung po'i rims rnams dang / rlung las gyur pa rnams dang / mkhris pa las gyur pa rnams dang / bad kan las gyur pa rnams dang / 'dus pa las gyur pa rnams dang / rims nad thams cad dang / klad pa na ba dang / gzhogs phyed na ba dang / yi ga 'chus pa dang / mig nad dang / sna nad dang / kha nad dang / mgul nad dang / snying nad dang / lkog ma'i lha gor na ba dang /

rna ba na ba dang / so na ba dang / snying na ba dang / klad pa na ba dang / rtsibs log na ba dang / rgyab na ba dang / lto ba na ba dang / sked pa na ba dang / chu so na ba dang / brla na ba dang / rje ngar na ba dang / lag pa na ba dang / rkang pa na ba dang / yan lag na ba dang / nying lag na ba dang / khyad par du yang 'brum pa dang / be ge dang / cham pa dang / klad gzer dang / gag pa dang / gzer thung dang / gnyan glang dang / rgyu gzer dang / me dbal dang / rmen bu dang / nywa log dang / lhog pa dang / 'bras dang / 'dzum ltag sgyed dang / mkhris pa rtsa rgyug dang / nad lhog dang / kha med dang / 'khyams po dang / 'bar 'bur dang / rna rtsa phus 'debs dang / ngam ru la sogs pa dus min gyi gnyan nad rnams dang / mdor na nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi sogs lus ngag yid gsum la gnod par byed pa thams cad til 'bru tsam yang ma gtong zhig bsam ngan gdug rtsub gnod 'tshe'i bsam pa thams cad zhi zhing gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems rin po che rgyud la skyes nas/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas thog drangs sems can thams cad la phan sems dang ldan par gyis shig nad rims yams bdag rnams kyi rgyud la/ byang chub sems mchog rin po che'i/ /ma skyes pa rnams skyes gyur cig /skyes pa nyams pa med par yang / /gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog /chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung nas/ 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye'i bar/ oṃ chen po'i nas/ nad de rab tu sol mdzod la/ /gdon khyod rang gi gnas su dengs/ /lo ga pa ti sa pa ri wā ra gatstsha/ na mo badzra sogs drag rol dang bcas pas gtor ma rgyang ring du 'phen/ thal mo sbyar la/ tadya thā/ tsa le mi tsa le mi pa na ko ki li shri ma ri/ guṇḍa li/ dundhu bhi/ ind+ra ni mu khe swāhā/ 'di dag ni zas ma zhu ba dang / sbos pa dang khrag dang mkhris pa 'dres pa dang / gzhang 'brum gyis btab pa dang / gzhang nad can dang / za khu dang / lud pa can dang /

rims nad can dang / klad pa na ba dang / gzhogs phyed na ba dang / yi dwags kyis zin pa'i gsang sngags kyi gzhi yin te/ gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag las 'gal bar byed pa de ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na ma mthong ngo / /gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa ste/ 'di la sangs rgyas ni sems can thams cad kyi mchog 'dod chags dang bral ba ni/ chos thams cad kyi mchog go /dge 'dun ni tshogs thams cad kyi mchog go /bden pa'i tshig dang bden pa'i ngag 'dis bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas thog drangs sems can thams cad kyis zos pa dang / 'thung pa dang / 'chos pa dang / myang pa rnams legs par bde bar zhu bar gyur cig swāhā/ tadya thā/ dzwa la ni/ dzwa la ni/ pra dzwa la ni/ pra ti pa ni/ pra sha ma ni/ bdag cag dpon slob nas sems can thams cad kyi bar gong bzhin dang / rims nad song zhig ma 'dug cig swāhā/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis 'jig rten na sangs rgyas bla na med pa dang / chos bla na med pa dang / dge 'dun bla na med pa'i bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des bdag cag dpon slob nas sems can thams cad kyi bar gong bzhin la/ rims nad spongs shig ma 'dug cig swāhā/ zhes brjod/ brgyad pa 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi khams kyi nad bdag gdug pa can dkar la dga' ba thams cad a karṣa ya dzaḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te sogs kyis sbyin/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ dril bu rgyun chags su dkrol la/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po nas dkar gtor 'phen pa'i bar brjod de nas nang du log la sgrub khang du tadya thā nas ma 'dug gcig bar thal mo sbyar nas brjod/ de nas mjug chog ma 'dug cig swāhā'i bar gong bzhin/

dgu pa 'bru gsum byin gyis brlabs/ bhu mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra ā karṣa ya dzaḥ sngags de nyid la ā ka ro btags pas phul/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ dril bu rgyun chags su dkrol la/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyis gtso byas pa'i 'dzam bu gling bzhi'i bdag po rnams dang / khyad par du yang bod khams skyong bar byed pa'i bstan ma bcu gnyis/ sgos dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ bye brag tu yul phyogs dang sa phyogs 'di nyid na gnas pa'i lha/ klu/ btsan/ bdud/ rgyal po/ ma mo/ sa bdagaganyan mthu bo che/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag yul bdag grong bdag dkor bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /'jig rten gyi khams su char chu dus su 'bab pa dang / lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa dang / mi nad dang phyugs nad dang mu ge thams cad rgyun chad cing mi 'byung ba dang / dus kyi 'khrug pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang / rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad 'gro na ma chags/ 'dug na ma dogs/ 'gro ba la bshol 'debs ma byed/ sdod pa la bskul ma ma byed/ gnas mgron gyi dam tsig bsrung / bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad 'gro 'dug bya ba spyod lam ci byas kyang ru nga ba dang phrag dog par ma mdzad par chos dang mthun pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod cig chos rnams thams cad sogs nas/ 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye'i bar bhu mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra gatstsha zhes brjod/ bgegs gtor 'phags pa rin po che'i cho ga nas ma gsungs shing / btang na mi 'gal lam snyam/ gtong na 'dir btang / gtor ma'o/ /de nas mchod rten gyi nang na yod pa'i rten oṃ a mṛ ta nas mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs gong bzhin la mchod yon phal cher gyis mchod bstod rgyas pa bya/

rnams la mchod bstod bsdus pa bya/ sems can gyi nad zhi bar gsol ba gdab/ 'gro ba nad pa sogs༞ sems can nad pa sogs༞ phyogs rnams kun na sogs༞ phyogs bcu'i sems can gang rnams sogs༞ bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad dang rims kun sogs nas༞ dri ma thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol kyi bar sa skya'i nad grol ma sogs brjod do/ /yi ge brgya pa lan gsum ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs/ gang yang bdag blo'i sogs/ gtso bor nus pa sogs/ mchod rten la brtan bzhugs/ gshegs gsol mi dgos/ dge ba 'di yis sogs༞ bsod nams 'di yis༞ sangs rgyas sku gsum༞ bsam pa rnam par༞ ston mchog dam pa sogs༞ dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i rnam rgyal stong mchod kyi mjug nas 'byung ba sogs bzod par gsol/ gtor ma'i mgron rnams gshegs su gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sogs/ dge ba bsngo shis pa brjod/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag sogs/ de ltar thun bzhi'i rim pas zhag gsum mam bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du sgrub pa byas pa'i mthar/ bzod par gsol zhing yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang la dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bya'o/ /bum pa'i steng na mchod rten yod na gshegs gsol mi dgos shing / gal te mchod rten med na bum pa'i nang ngam steng du lha bskyed par bya ste/ mthar ye shes sems dpa' gshegs su gsol nas/ dam tshig pa zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur blta'o/ /sgrub par nam byed kyi bar nyin re bzhin 'og nas 'byung ba'i sbyang ba nas shis pa brjod pa'i bar tshar re sgrub khang gi dbus nas bya'o/ /gzungs kyi sgrub pa bstan zin to/ /khrus kyi cho ga ni/ sgrub bya nyung ngu'i don byed na dngos su bkru zhing / ku sha la sogs pas spyi bo nas gtor la khrus kyi tshigs bcad dang sngags rim pa bzhin brjod par bya'o/ /skye bo mang po'i grong khyer ram/

/rta phyugs mang po'i don byed na/ /grong khyer bskor ba'i phyir dung dang rnga dang / ba dan la sogs rol mo sna tshogs pas sna drangs te lha mo'i ri khrod ma sngon mo sku dang tog gzungs dang 'di'i gzungs mdo glegs bam dang gtor ma rnams gtso gtor sbyangs shing sngags mkhan dang / rdor dril gsor dkrol byed cing / dge 'dun rnams dang / pi sha tsi 'ur 'don byed/ mi dpa' bo go cha gyon zhing mtshon cha thogs pa mang po dang bcas pas/ 'dre gdon nad bdag la bsdigs par byed cing / 'dre gdon bskrod pa'i drag sngags dang / sgra skad chen pos khu 'debs pa mang pos bskor ba/ mi de dag gi mgo la shing lo la parṇa sha wa ri'i snying po ghi haṃ gis bris pa btags shing / thams cad kyis sngags bzlos bzhin pas rang nyid parṇa sha wa ri las bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa dang / sngags g.yogs 'phags pa kun dga' bo dang / 'khor rnams shā wa ri'i 'khor dang bcas pa dang byang chub sems dpa' dge 'dun dang phyogs skyong ba dang 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur pa rnams kyis grong de'i nad gdon bskrad cing / nad yams zhi ba dang / 'jig rten la phan gdags pa'i phyir gshegs so/ /zhes brda sprod do/ /kun gyi thugs mthun par dgos shing grong khyer bskor la/ grong de'i lho phyogs kyi sgo'i phyi rol du/ shin tu gtsang zhing mtho ba'i sar me long la de dag gi gzugs brnyan 'char du bcug la/ gtor mas sgrub bya de dag la bskor zhing / oṃ sarba bighnan na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu ṣe bheḥ sarba thad khaṃ udga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhṇe daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swāhā/ deng 'dir bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas thog drangs sems can thams cad la gnod par byed pa'i nad rims yams bdag bgegs dang 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad gtor ma lam brngan/

zhes pa'i sngags dang bcas pas gsum mam bdun gyis de dag la gnod par byed pa rnams la zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba spyi 'gro byin la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas khro bo spyan 'dren bstod pa dang bcas pa'i rjes la/ skye bo 'di dag la gnod par byed pa'i nad bdag bgegs dang 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad tshim par gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par song zhig ces brjod la drag po'i sngags dang / rol mo'i sgra drag po bya'o/ /mi'i rus pa/ sha/ skra/ sen mo/ shing kun sgog skya ga pur nyungs dkar/ gla ba/ sbrul pags rnams sbyar ba la/ bdag bskyed kyi gzungs ring rdzogs nas sngags 'di nyid gcig bzlas la rdzas rnams la nyin ltar gyi phu btab/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te rud tra ya/ tadya thā/ pa ra pa ra/ pra sa ra pra sa ra/ ga ha ga ha bi ga bhi gi ga ha/ ti li ti li/ a la/ thā/ ha yi ni/ ga ga ṭa ṭa tud tro/ nya pa a ti tha tha/ tsu lu tsu lu tsu lu ka tha tha/ zhes nyer gcig bzlas pas bsreg cing / grong khyer thams cad du bdug la/ thams cad kyis 'dre gdon bskrod pa'i sngags dang khrus gdab par bya'o/ /de nas nad gdon sdig sgrib rnams til la bstim rab gnas sogs nas 'byung ba bzhin la/ mer bsreg pas sdig pa sbyangs/ til sbyangs ni sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon bar chad kyi rigs thams cad sna sgo sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur te mdun gyi til 'di nyid la yongs su thim par gyur/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ dha ha na badzra ye swāhā/ zhes gsum mam nyer gcig la sogs pa brjod/ sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad shīntiṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ de nas grong khyer la sogs pa me long gi nang du shar ba la bum pa'i chus bkrus shing / 'di ni khrus mchog sogs dang / ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la/ /zhes sogs dang / 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin nas/

dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ /zhes pa'i bar sngags dang bcas pas khrus bya/ sku phyi ba'ang bya'o/ /de nas rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la nyan thos dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang / phyogs skyong dang 'jig rten pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba byon nas/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas thog drangs sems can thams cad kyi nad dang gdon dang rims dang 'tshe ba la sogs pa'i 'gal rkyen thams cad sel ba la dgongs pa rtse gcig tu mdzad par bsam zhing / 'dod pa'i grogs dang bcas pas 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /bi sa ra ta bi sa ra ta/ bi sa ra ta/ bi sa ra ta/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba can gyis bka' stsal to/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsam pa dgra bcom pa thams cad kyi bsam pa slob pa thams cad kyi bsam pa/ nyan thos thams cad kyi bsam pa/ bden pa'i tshig dang ldan pa thams cad kyi bsam pa/ chos kyi bsam pa/ tshangs pa'i bsam pa/ tshangs pa so so'i bsam pa/ 'dod pa'i byang chub kyi bsam pa/ dbang po'i bsam pa/ lha'i bsam pa/ lha ma yin gyi dbang po'i bsam pa/ lha ma yin thams cad kyi bsam pa/ lha ma yin gyi mngag gzhug pa'i bsam pa/ 'byung po thams cad kyi bsam pa/ bi sa ra ta/ bi sa ra ta/ bi sa ra ta/ bi sa ra ta/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba can gyis bka' stsal pa/ mun tsa ta/ mun tsa ta/ ma 'dug cig yams kyi nad rnams zhi bar gyur cig rol mo drag po bya/ bum chu gtor/ 'og ma rnams la'ang 'gre/ nir gatstsha ta/ nir gatstsha ta/ nir gatstsha ta/ nir gatstsha ta/ sangs rgyas lha chen po/ lha yi yang lha/ lha'i bla ma gshegs shing dbang po dang bcas pa'i lha rnams dang / tshangs pa dang bcas pa'i lha rnams dang / dbang bdag dang bcas pa'i lha rnams dang / skye rgu'i bdag po dang bcas pa'i lha rnams dang / 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi po dag kyang 'ong /

lha 'bum phrag du ma dag kyang 'ong / lha ma yin gyi dbang po rnams dang / lha ma yin 'bum phrag du ma dag kyang 'ong / bcom ldan 'das la mngon par dad pa'i 'byung po 'bum phrag du ma dag kyang sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir 'ong ste/ de dag khyed rnams la gnod pa chen po byed par 'gyur du 'ong gis/ nir gatstsha ta/ nir gatstsha ta/ nir gatstsha ta/ nir gatstsha ta/ myur du byer shig khyed cag las gang sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa de dag ni phung bar gyur cig gang dag byams pa'i sems dang ldan zhing nyes par mi 'dod la bsrung bar 'jug par 'dod pa de dag ni 'khod cig lus la yang 'jug par gyur cig sangs rgyas 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba can gyis bka' stsal pa/ su mu su mu/ su mu su mu/ su mu ru su mu ru/ su mu ru su mu ru/ su mu ru/ su mu ru/ su mu ru su mu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ mu ru/ mi ri mi ri/ mi ri mi ri/ mi ri mi ri/ mi ri mi ri/ mi ri mu ru mi ri/ mu ru mi ri/ mu ru mi ri/ mu ru mi ri/ mu ru mi ri/ mu ru mi ri/ mu ru mi ri/ mu ru mi ri/ mu ru mi ri/ mu ru mi ri/ mu ru mi ri/ mu ru mi ri/ mu ru mi ri/ mu ru mi ri/ rī ti dang / ri ri/ ri ri/ rī rī/ rī rī/ rī rī ti/ mi ri/ mi ri/ mi ri/ mi ri/ mi ri/ mi ri/ mi ri/ mi ri ti/ ha so mi ri ti/ mi ri ti/ mi ti/ si sāe/ si mī/ kaṃ ka ra/ kaṃ ka rā ta/ kaṃ ka rā/kaṃ ka tsā/ kaṃ ka ra/ kaṃ ka ra/ kaṃ ka ra/ kaṃ ka ra/ kaṃ ka ra/ kaṃ ka ra/ kaṃ ka ra/ kaṃ ka ra/ kaṃ ka ra/ kaṃ ka ra/ kaṃ ka ra/ kaṃ ka ra/ kaṃ ka ra/ kaṃ ka ra/ kaṃ ka ra/ kaṃ ka ra/ kaṃ ka ro/ ti ti ku ru sho kaṃ ka rā/ kaṃ ka rī sho ri ri ri ri/ ri ri ti ri ti/ phu su ri su ri su/ ri su/ ri su/ ri su/ ri su/ ri su/ ri su/ ri su/ ri su/ na thā na thā/ thā tha/ ri phu ri phu/ nā thā thā/ nir gatstsha ta/ri phu ri phu nirgatstsha te/

sā la ya ta/ ri phu ri phu sā la ya ta/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba can/ sems can thams cad la phan pa lhag par dgongs pa dang ldan pa/ byams pa la gnas pa thugs rje dang ldan pa/ dga' ba la gnas pa/ byams pa la gnas pa/ btang snyoms la gnas pa/ rol mo drag po bya zhing bum chu gtor/ gshegs kyi kī phraṃ nir gatstsha ta swāhā/ zhes rol mo bzhag sangs rgyas ye shes kyi mchog dang / chos nyid kyi lha thams cad dang / 'byung po thams cad la bka' stsal ba'i gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag ni grub pas so/ /tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag ni grub pas so/ /zhes brjod do/ /yang sgrub pa'i grogs dang bcas pa 'ga' zhig gi dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ yang na mgrin gcig tu sdebs la/ skad gsang mthon pos 'di skad ces/ 'dir bcom dril gril byed/ gang la ser sna rnam chags pa/ /rnam 'joms dri ma med mdzad cing / /thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams/ /thar pa'i lam du 'dzud mdzad cing / /chos rnams thams cad ston pa des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyis rten/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /gang la bde ba mnga' mdzad des/ /khyed la༞ /skyobs pa gang zhig byams pa yis/ /thugs kyi 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /bu gcig bzhin du rtag bskyangs des/ /khyed la༞ /gang zhig 'khor ba'i 'gro ba yi/ /sems can kun gyis brten gyur cing / /gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa des/ /khyed la༞ gang zhig chos kun mngon sum 'gyur/ /gtsang zhing bslu ba mi mnga' la/ /gsung gtsang gtsang mar mdzad pa des/ /khyed la༞ /dpa' bo chen po gang skyes pa/ /phun sum tshogs don 'byor gyur cing / /don grub tshogs kyang 'grub pa des/ /khyed la༞ /gang zhig skyes pa'i sa rnams dang / /nags tshal bcas par rab g.yos shing / /sems can thams cad rab dga' des/ /khyed la༞

/byang chub snying po gshegs pa na/ /sa dag rnam drug g.yos gyur zhing / /bdud yid mi bder 'gyur ba des/ /khyed la༞ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnam gsung zhing / /thub pa'i bstan pa gang byung des/ /khyed la༞ /yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byed/ /thams cad chos kyis pham mdzad cing / /tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pa des/ /khyed la༞ /sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad/ /brgya byin tshangs pa'i lha rnams dang / /'byung po kun gyi bde legs ni/ /khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig /sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang / /lha rnams kun gyi bsam pa yis/ /khyed kyi 'dod don gang yin pa/ /don de de ring 'grub gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog /khyed cag lam 'gro bde legs shog /phyir 'ong dag kyang bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing / /khyed cag kun tu bde legs shog /khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /sangs rgyas lha rnams stong dag gis/ /yongs su bskor te gshegs mdzad cing / /sdang sems ldan pa rnams byer zhing / /snying rje'i bdag nyid can rnams 'khod/ /sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas rnams dang / /dgra bcom slob pa'i bden tshig gis/ /'jig rten mi phan byed pa rnams/ /grong khyer 'di nas stong gyur cig /sems can kun dang srog chags kun/ /'byung po kun dang khyed cag kun/ /bde ba 'ba' zhig ldan gyur cig /thams cad nad rnams med par shog /kun gyi bzang rnams mthong gyur cig /gang yang sdig par ma gyur cig /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhag gyur te/ /sa'am 'on te bar snang 'khod kyang rung / /skye rgu kun la rtag tu byams byed cing / /nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod par shog /ces brjod du gzhug go /rang gi ku sha de bar slob dpon kyis tshig ci rigs brjod/

la sogs pas bum pa'i chu gtor zhing / oṃ pi shā tsi parṇaṇa sha wa ri ma ra pra sha ma na ye che ge mo'i grong khyer pa'am rta'i tshogs sam/ phyugs la sogs pas bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas thog drangs sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa la sogs pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ nad thams cad༞ gdon thams cad༞ rims thams cad༞ gza' dang rgyu skar gyi gnod pa thams cad༞ rgyal po'i gnod pa thams cad༞ mi rgod kyi gnod pa thams cad༞ gcan gzan gyi gnod pa thams cad༞ byad stems thams cad༞ gzhon nu'i gdon thams cad༞ phas kyi rgol ba thams cad༞ bkra mi shis pa thams cad༞ rmi lam ngan pa thams cad༞ mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad༞ ltas ngan pa thams cad༞ skag sri ngan pa thams cad༞ mdor na mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes brjod nad kun zhi bar gyur cig la sogs pa'i smon lam gdab bo/ / 'dir yang gong bkod bzhin na ba'i tshigs bcad rnams bton la/ bum chus mi phyugs thams cad la gtor bas nad thams cad zhi bar bsam/ de nas lho sgo'i nang nas rkang pa g.yas pas them pa mnan la 'di'i gzungs gleng gzhi mtshams gcod skabs bzhin dang bcas pa lan gsum bklag te/ mtshams gcod byin gyis brlabs pa'i rig sngags bum steng gi shog dril thum bu gcig bris pas ya them la brlan/ rig sngags dang bcas pa'i shing lo gsar pa sgo gong du btsugs pas bsrung ngo / /de bzhin du nub sgo dang /byang dang / shar du'ang cho ga rnams tshang bar bya'o/ /rims drag po bcad pa la/ lho sgo na/ shar dang / byang dang / nub tu bskor bas cho ga drag po bya'o/ /de nas lha mo'i sngags thum bu gcig dang shing lo dang bcas pa grong gi dbus su rgyal mtshan gyi rtse la btsugs la mchod pa rgya der chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mchod pa sogs rnam grangs mang bar bshams la bsangs sbyangs byin brlabs/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho sogs tshigs bcad dang /

mtshan sngags sngon 'gros mchod pa rgyal srid sna bdun/ 'dod yon lnga spyi 'gro bzhin la/ mos blos rgyal ba sras bcas la 'bul na/ /zhes sogs phul mthar bstod pa rgyas pa dang / nad zhi ba'i tshigs bcad gzungs ring tshar nyer gcig sogs kyi mthar bkra shis brjod do/ /chen pos mchod cing bstod nas nad zhi bar gsol gdab/ gzungs tshar gsum la sogs pa bzlas pas brtan par bya'o/ /de ltar thams cad kyis sems can thams cad la phan pa'i bsam pas 'dun pa gcig pas cho ga bya zhing / lha mo dus thams cad du mchod cing nad zhi bar gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /khrus kyi cho ga bstan zin to/ /dngos gzhi cho ga'o/ /rjes ni maṇḍal dang mchod pa rnams bsdu/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya/ slob dpon 'khor dang bcas pa dga' ston gyis mnyes par bya zhing bsngo ba dang smon lam rgya cher gdab shis pa brjod par bya'o/ /rjes kyi cho ga'o/ /de ltar sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis ri khrod ma'i cho ga bstan zin to/ /'jig rten khams 'dir thub pa'i dbang po yi/ /gdul bya gang la gang gis 'dul ba yis/ /chos kyi sgron me sna tshogs gsal bar gsungs/ /khyad par 'gro mang nad kyis zin pa la/ /lo ma gyon ma'i cho ga rjes su gnang / /de yi gdams pa byin rlabs chu rgyun 'di/ /brtse chen ba ri ba las legs brgyud de/ /rje btsun sa skya pa la bka' babs nas/ /cho ga'i rnam grangs shin tu gsal bar mdzad/ /bdag la de bas lhag pa ci byar yod/ /'on kyang blo dman rnams la 'jug bde dang / /blo gsal rnams la spro ba bskyed pa dang / /'gro mang nad kyis gzir ba mthong gyur nas/ /brtse ba'i bsam pas 'di nyid bris pa yin/ /nyes pa mchis na mkhas rnams bzod par gsol/ /legs pa'i dge bas nad rnams zhi gyur cig /nad rims gcod pa'i gdams ngag la/ /'di las zab pa yod mi srid/ /'di 'dra'i cho ga ma mthong zhing / /gdams ngag su sud re tsam gyis/
